documents.title: Doc 67 - Infringement - Car 12 - Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 12 - Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times

details.fact: Car 12 left the track four times during the race.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
details.decision: 5 second time penalty imposed after the Race.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The car left the track four times during the race without justifiable reason. The Stewards acknowledge that the driver did not receive a black/white flag after his third infringement but rather after his fourth infringement as one earlier infringement was only detected later in the race. However, based on the current regulations and Driving Standards Guidelines, this does not exempt the driver from complying with the regulations. As there might be some ambiguity in the relevant guidelines, the Stewards recommend the FIA revisit the current procedures and guidelines as soon as possible.

documents.title: Doc 64 - Infringement - Car 55 - Start Procedure Infringement
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 55 - Start Procedure Infringement

details.fact: The Mechanics of Car 55 left equipment on the grass area next to the grid after the 15 second signal.
details.infringement: Breach of Article B5.5.5.a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: The competitor (Atlassian Williams F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative, reviewed video evidence and a marshal report. The team left a black plastic box on the grass area next to the grid and thereby did not take all of their equipment with them after the 15 second signal.

documents.title: Doc 63 - Infringement - Car 23 - Start Procedure Infringement
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 23 - Start Procedure Infringement

details.fact: Car 23 started the formation lap with parts of a tyre blanket still on the car.
details.infringement: Breach of Article B5.5.5.a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: The competitor (Atlassian Williams F1 Team) is fined €5,000
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. When Car 23 was released from its jacks before the start of the formation lap parts of the right front tyre blanket got caught under the car. Although the team tried to remove the parts before the start of the formation lap, these attempts were unsuccessful and car left with a cable still hanging off the car and the team thereby did not take all of their equipment with them after the 15 second signal.

documents.title: Doc 62 - Infringement - Car 43 - Failing to slow for yellow flags
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 43 - Failing to slow for yellow flags

details.fact: Car 43 failed to slow for a single yellow flag
details.infringement: Breach of Article B1.8.4 a. of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: 10 second time penalty imposed after the Race. 1 penalty point (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 43 (Franco Colapinto), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The Stewards determine that, albeit the driver of Car 43 slightly reduced speed before entering the single yellow flag zone, but did not discernibly reduce speed in the relevant yellow flag sector. The Stewards acknowledge that the driver reacted to the yellow flag but do not consider the reaction to be sufficient to comply with the regulations. Therefore a penalty on the lower end of the applicable scale of penalties is imposed.

documents.title: Doc 58 - Decision - Car 41 - Alleged leaving the track and gaining an advantage
documents.subject: Decision - Car 41 - Alleged leaving the track and gaining an advantage

details.competitor: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team
details.fact: Car 41 allegedly left the track and gained an advantage in Turn 2
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: No further action.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Cars 41, 27 and 43 were alongside each other going into turn 1 after the race start. Car 41 left the track and rejoined ahead of Cars 27 and 43, subsequently giving back a position to Car 27. The Stewards considered the positioning of the cars before entering turn 1 (i.e. the braking point) and the circumstances under which the cars left the track. They also took into account that the incident happened in lap 1, turn 1. The Stewards determine that no lasting advantage has been gained by Car 41 and take no further action.

documents.title: Doc 52 - Infringement - Car 14 - PU elements and changes used during Parc Ferme
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 14 - PU elements and changes used during Parc Ferme

details.fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 4th MGU-K All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc fermé.
details.infringement: Breaches of Article B8.2.2 (read with B8.2.3), B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
details.decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
details.reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B3.5.3 a. and B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 30 places. Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations provides that a driver which has accrued more than 15 cumulative grid position penalties must start from the back of the grid. As parts of the car were replaced under parc ferme conditions without the approval of the Technical Delegate a pit lane start is mandated in accordance with Article B3.5.3 a.

details.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc), team representative and reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 27 was closing in on Car 16 while being on an in lap. Car 16 was passing Car 44 at a slow speed when Car 27 was approaching and thereby slightly impeded Car 27. documents.title: Doc 39 - Infringement - Car 12 - Driving erratically
documents.subject: Infringement - Car 12 - Driving erratically

details.fact: Car 12 was driving in an erratic manner in turn 2.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver’s 1st reprimand of the season.
details.reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli) and team representatives of Mercedes and Aston Martin and reviewed video, telemetry and in- car video evidence. Car 12 was impacted by Car 18 when approaching turn 1. After passing Car 18 the driver of Car 12 applied the brakes in front of Car 18 and prevented the latter from passing. This is deemed driving in an erratic manner. The driver admitted during the hearing that he acted out of frustration and apologized for his action.
